# S1 Information architecture

# Information architecture

Two full pages. Everything else is a layer over the reading canvas — summoned at the point of intent, dismissed without losing your place.

### Library Full page

- Continue reading
- All books · cover grid
- Search title / author
- Sort: Recent · Title · Author
- Item menu: Book info · Show file · Remove

### Preferences Window

- Reading defaults
- Extensions · permissions
- Shortcuts · About
open · 1 click
⌘L · saves place
.epub from OS skips library

### Reader Full page never unloaded while layers open

Reading canvas always present · Pages or Scroll · the only thing visible at rest
Chrome Transient overlay Top: Library · Contents · Search · Notes · Aa · ⋯ — Bottom: progress scrubber · Go to
**Navigator** Sidebar
Contents Search Notes + extension tab
Left, 320 px, docks ≥ 1100 px, floats below
**Popovers** Anchored

Anchored to the control that opened them
